description: Tools that let someone see and control this computer or another one over the network, attended or unattended.
examples: AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RustDesk, Chrome Remote Desktop, Splashtop, Parsec

description: Agents of IT management platforms that run scripts, install software and open remote sessions.
examples: NinjaOne, Datto RMM, Atera, ConnectWise Automate

description: Software that accepts incoming remote desktop connections on this computer.
examples: RealVNC Server, TightVNC, UltraVNC, RDP Wrapper

description: Clients used to open shells on other systems.
examples: PuTTY, MobaXterm, Termius, Windows Terminal

description: VPN clients usually deployed by the organization to reach internal networks.

description: Personal VPN or proxy apps and browser extensions that route traffic through a third-party service.

description: Tools that expose local services to the internet or join the computer to an overlay network.

description: Software built to hide the user's identity or bypass network controls.

description: Clients for moving files to and from servers.
